definition: Qualities that characterize a trustworthy and mature good person in doctrinal and ethical instruction.
notes: Use this record for named person-quality frameworks such as MN 113. Keep the compound aligned with sappurisa as 'good person' rather than flattening it into generic virtue-language.

example_phrases.translation: not seeing true persons, unskilled in the dhamma of true persons
example_phrases.notes: From the opening description of the untaught ordinary person.
